CHOKE.gloss: breathe with great difficulty, as when experiencing a strong emotion
CHOKE.definition: Breathe with great difficulty, as when experiencing a strong emotion.
CHOKE.example: She choked with emotion when she spoke about her deceased husband.

CODE.gloss: a set of rules or principles or laws
CODE.definition: A set of rules or principles or laws (especially written ones).

DECK.gloss: any of various platforms built into a vessel
DECK.definition: Any of various platforms built into a vessel.

COKE.gloss: carbon fuel produced by distillation of coal
COKE.definition: Carbon fuel produced by distillation of coal.

ECHO.example: Followers echoing the cries of their leaders.

DOCK.gloss: an enclosure in a court of law where the defendant sits during the trial
DOCK.definition: An enclosure in a court of law where the defendant sits during the trial.

DOC.example: I felt so bad I went to see my doctor.

COD.gloss: the vessel that contains the seeds of a plant
COD.definition: The vessel that contains the seeds of a plant (not the seeds themselves).

DECO.gloss: a style of design that was popular in the 1920s and 1930s
DECO.definition: A style of design that was popular in the 1920s and 1930s; marked by stylized forms and geometric designs adapted to mass production.
